audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra scale-affliction cleansing and house-affliction text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for cleansing of scale-afflicted person, birds/wood/scarlet/hyssop rite, shaving/washing, offerings with poverty option, house affliction inspection/remediation/cleansing.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: This shall be Torah/instruction of one afflicted with scale-disease/tzaraat in day of his cleansing: he shall be brought to priest.

familiar.text: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

modern.text: “This is the law for the one afflicted with a skin disease on the day of his cleansing, when he is brought to the priest.

original.text: זֹ֤את תִּֽהְיֶה֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת הַמְּצֹרָ֔ע בְּי֖וֹם טָהֳרָת֑וֹ וְהוּבָ֖א אֶל הַכֹּהֵֽן

verses.restored: Priest shall go out to outside camp, and priest shall look; if affliction of scale-disease is healed from afflicted one,

familiar.text: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

modern.text: The priest is to go outside the camp to examine him, and if the skin disease of the afflicted person has healed,

original.text: וְיָצָא֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְרָאָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה נִרְפָּ֥א נֶֽגַע הַצָּרַ֖עַת מִן הַצָּרֽוּעַ

verses.restored: priest shall command, and for the one being cleansed they shall take two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

familiar.text: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

modern.text: the priest shall order that two live clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop be brought for the one to be cleansed.

original.text: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלָקַ֧ח לַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר שְׁתֵּֽי צִפֳּרִ֥ים חַיּ֖וֹת טְהֹר֑וֹת וְעֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּשְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֵזֹֽב

verses.restored: Priest shall command, and one bird shall be slaughtered into earthen vessel over living water.

familiar.text: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

modern.text: Then the priest shall command that one of the birds be slaughtered over fresh water in a clay pot.

original.text: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְשָׁחַ֖ט אֶת הַצִּפּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֑ת אֶל כְּלִי חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים

verses.restored: The living bird he shall take, and cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop, and dip them and living bird in blood/life of bird slaughtered over living water.

familiar.text: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

modern.text: And he is to take the live bird together with the cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop, and dip them into the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the fresh water.

original.text: אֶת הַצִּפֹּ֤ר הַֽחַיָּה֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֹתָ֔הּ וְאֶת עֵ֥ץ הָאֶ֛רֶז וְאֶת שְׁנִ֥י הַתּוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֶת הָאֵזֹ֑ב וְטָבַ֨ל אוֹתָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּ֗ה בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַשְּׁחֻטָ֔ה עַ֖ל הַמַּ֥יִם הַֽחַיִּֽים

verses.restored: He shall sprinkle on one being cleansed from scale-disease seven times, declare him clean, and send living bird over face of field.

familiar.text: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

modern.text: Seven times he shall sprinkle the one to be cleansed of the skin disease. Then he shall pronounce him clean and release the live bird into the open field.

original.text: וְהִזָּ֗ה עַ֧ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר מִן הַצָּרַ֖עַת שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִ֣הֲר֔וֹ וְשִׁלַּ֛ח אֶת הַצִּפֹּ֥ר הַֽחַיָּ֖ה עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה

verses.restored: The one being cleansed shall wash garments, shave off all hair, wash in water, and be clean; afterward he may come into camp but dwell outside his tent seven days.

familiar.text: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

modern.text: The one being cleansed must wash his clothes, shave off all his hair, and bathe with water; then he will be ceremonially clean. Afterward, he may enter the camp, but he must remain outside his tent for seven days.

original.text: וְכִבֶּס֩ הַמִּטַּהֵ֨ר אֶת בְּגָדָ֜יו וְגִלַּ֣ח אֶת כָּל שְׂעָר֗וֹ וְרָחַ֤ץ בַּמַּ֨יִם֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר וְאַחַ֖ר יָב֣וֹא אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְיָשַׁ֛ב מִח֥וּץ לְאָהֳל֖וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים

verses.restored: On seventh day he shall shave all his hair, head, beard, eyebrows, all hair he shall shave; wash garments, wash flesh in water, and be clean.

familiar.text: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

modern.text: On the seventh day he must shave off all his hair—his head, his beard, his eyebrows, and the rest of his hair. He must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and he will be clean.

original.text: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י יְגַלַּ֣ח אֶת כָּל שְׂעָר֗וֹ אֶת רֹאשׁ֤וֹ וְאֶת זְקָנוֹ֙ וְאֵת֙ גַּבֹּ֣ת עֵינָ֔יו וְאֶת כָּל שְׂעָר֖וֹ יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְכִבֶּ֣ס אֶת בְּגָדָ֗יו וְרָחַ֧ץ אֶת בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָהֵֽר

verses.restored: On eighth day he shall take two complete male lambs, one complete female lamb daughter of a year, three-tenths fine flour mixed with oil for grain offering, and one log of oil.

familiar.text: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

modern.text: On the eighth day he is to bring two unblemished male lambs, an unblemished ewe lamb a year old, a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with olive oil, and one log of olive oil.

original.text: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִקַּ֤ח שְׁנֵֽי כְבָשִׂים֙ תְּמִימִ֔ים וְכַבְשָׂ֥ה אַחַ֛ת בַּת שְׁנָתָ֖הּ תְּמִימָ֑ה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְלֹ֥ג אֶחָ֖ד שָֽׁמֶן

verses.restored: Priest who cleanses shall stand the man being cleansed and these things before YHWH at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

modern.text: The priest who performs the cleansing shall present the one to be cleansed, together with these offerings, before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְהֶעֱמִ֞יד הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַֽמְטַהֵ֗ר אֵ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר וְאֹתָ֑ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Priest shall take one male lamb and bring it near for guilt/reparation offering with log of oil, and wave them as wave offering before YHWH.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:

modern.text: Then the priest is to take one of the male lambs and present it as a guilt offering, along with the log of olive oil; and he must wave them as a wave offering before the LORD.

original.text: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֗ד וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֛וֹ לְאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְהֵנִ֥יף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: He shall slaughter lamb in place where sin/misalignment offering and burnt offering are slaughtered, in holy place, for guilt/reparation offering like sin/misalignment offering belongs to priest; Holy of Holies it is.

familiar.text: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

modern.text: Then he is to slaughter the lamb in the sanctuary area where the sin offering and burnt offering are slaughtered. Like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest; it is most holy.

original.text: וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֶת הַכֶּ֗בֶשׂ בִּ֠מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֧ט אֶת הַֽחַטָּ֛את וְאֶת הָעֹלָ֖ה בִּמְק֣וֹם הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כִּ֡י כַּ֠חַטָּאת הָאָשָׁ֥ם הוּא֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא

verses.restored: Priest shall take from blood/life of guilt/reparation offering and put on lobe of right ear of one being cleansed, on thumb of right hand, and on big toe of right foot.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

modern.text: The priest is to take some of the blood from the guilt offering and put it on the right earlobe of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

original.text: וְלָקַ֣ח הַכֹּהֵן֮ מִדַּ֣ם הָאָשָׁם֒ וְנָתַן֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַל תְּנ֛וּךְ אֹ֥זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית

verses.restored: Priest shall take from log of oil and pour into left palm of priest.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:

modern.text: Then the priest shall take some of the log of olive oil, pour it into his left palm,

original.text: וְלָקַ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן מִלֹּ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְיָצַ֛ק עַל כַּ֥ף הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית

verses.restored: Priest shall dip his right finger in oil that is in his left palm and sprinkle from oil with his finger seven times before YHWH.

familiar.text: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:

modern.text: dip his right forefinger into the oil in his left palm, and sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.

original.text: וְטָבַ֤ל הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת אֶצְבָּע֣וֹ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִן הַשֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל כַּפּ֖וֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֑ית וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן הַשֶּׁ֧מֶן בְּאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: From remainder of oil in his palm priest shall put on lobe of right ear of one being cleansed, on thumb of right hand, and on big toe of right foot, upon blood/life of guilt/reparation offering.

familiar.text: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

modern.text: And the priest is to put some of the oil remaining in his palm on the right earlobe of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.

original.text: וּמִיֶּ֨תֶר הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל כַּפּ֗וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן הַכֹּהֵן֙ עַל תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִ֑ית עַ֖ל דַּ֥ם הָאָשָֽׁם

verses.restored: Remaining oil in priest's palm he shall put on head of one being cleansed; priest shall make atonement/covering for him before YHWH.

familiar.text: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.

modern.text: The rest of the oil in his palm, the priest is to put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.

original.text: וְהַנּוֹתָ֗ר בַּשֶּׁ֨מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל כַּ֣ף הַכֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֑ר וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Priest shall make sin/misalignment offering and make atonement/covering for one being cleansed from his uncleanness; afterward he shall slaughter burnt offering.

familiar.text: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

modern.text: Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness. After that, the priest shall slaughter the burnt offering

original.text: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת הַ֣חַטָּ֔את וְכִפֶּ֕ר עַל הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר מִטֻּמְאָת֑וֹ וְאַחַ֖ר יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת הָעֹלָֽה

verses.restored: Priest shall bring up burnt offering and grain offering on altar; priest shall make atonement/covering for him, and he shall be clean.

familiar.text: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

modern.text: and offer it on the altar, with the grain offering, to make atonement for him, and he will be clean.

original.text: וְהֶעֱלָ֧ה הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת הָעֹלָ֥ה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטָהֵֽר

verses.restored: If he is poor and his hand does not reach, he shall take one male lamb for guilt/reparation offering to wave, to make atonement/covering for him, one-tenth fine flour mixed with oil for grain offering, a log of oil,

familiar.text: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

modern.text: If, however, the person is poor and cannot afford these offerings, he is to take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be waved to make atonement for him, along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with olive oil for a grain offering, a log of olive oil,

original.text: וְאִם דַּ֣ל ה֗וּא וְאֵ֣ין יָדוֹ֮ מַשֶּׂגֶת֒ וְ֠לָקַח כֶּ֣בֶשׂ אֶחָ֥ד אָשָׁ֛ם לִתְנוּפָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְעִשָּׂר֨וֹן סֹ֜לֶת אֶחָ֨ד בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן לְמִנְחָ֖ה וְלֹ֥ג שָֽׁמֶן

verses.restored: and two turtledoves or two sons of pigeon, as his hand reaches; one shall be sin/misalignment offering and one burnt offering.

familiar.text: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

modern.text: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, whichever he can afford, one to be a sin offering and the other a burnt offering.

original.text: וּשְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָד֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה אֶחָד֙ חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָֽה

verses.restored: On eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to priest, to entrance of tent of meeting, before YHWH.

familiar.text: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.

modern.text: On the eighth day he is to bring them for his cleansing to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD.

original.text: וְהֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜ם בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֛י לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ אֶל הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֶל פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Priest shall take lamb of guilt/reparation offering and log of oil, and priest shall wave them as wave offering before YHWH.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:

modern.text: The priest shall take the lamb for the guilt offering, along with the log of olive oil, and wave them as a wave offering before the LORD.

original.text: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת כֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְהֵנִ֨יף אֹתָ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

translation_notes: Priest goes outside camp to inspect healing, showing reintegration begins by meeting the separated person where they are.
Bird/cedar/scarlet/hyssop/living-water rite is complex symbolic cleansing; avoid over-allegorizing in source layer.
Ear/thumb/toe oil and blood echo priestly ordination, suggesting restoration to embodied life and community.
House affliction demonstrates tzaraat is not simply human disease; it includes material/environmental affliction.
safety_note: Do not use this chapter to shame disease, poverty, homes, or bodies. The cleansing rites aim at reintegration, restoration, and careful remediation, not stigma.
